title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a shared astral/pharma whole names a directed influence relation rather than its celestial actor
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Specialize IDEA640's relation rival using the already owned complete Sloane73 passage: named stars influence a drug, and that drug draws humours from selected bodily regions but explicitly not others. Explore okoaiin as one stable directed relation in the entire f68r2 paired rings and f89v1.13–20, without initially assigning it Sun or gold. The asymmetric source–drug–body chain supplies a concrete meaning obligation beyond a cross-register word match.

design.mechanism: The same relation can be predicated of different typed participants; an astral source acts through a medicine whose effect selects a bodily destination. It is not physical identity between the pictured celestial body and the drug.
design.unit: Both complete already admitted f68r2 upper and lower rings and the complete saved f89v1.13–20 paragraph, exactly as retained in E and GDT1051. No selection of two attractive initial groups; no new image.
design.contrast: A stable two-place influence predicate versus a celestial object-name repeated metaphorically as a metal, and versus direct sunlight supplying preparation heat.
design.prediction: A relation reading owes an ordered source and recipient at each occurrence; exchanging them reverses the claim. Its selected medical continuation must bind the influenced drug as agent of a region-selective effect and distinguish the explicitly excluded bodily region. Direct heating or naming a metal does not by itself supply that linked region-selective proposition. These extra obligations belong only to this selected account, not to every astrological or gold reading.
actual_referents: E Q1, Sloane73 c1460–70, complete BookI pp2–3/editorial f11r–11v: Aries/Taurus/Gemini give influence to Gerapigra Galieni, which draws surplus humours from head/neck/breast and explicitly not lower members; medicines for knees/legs/feet receive Capricorn/Aquarius/Pisces influence. This entire continuation is already preserved, not a fresh source search.

IDEA640 and E_ROOT_RESULT preserve upper crescent-face and lower radiating-face owners, unequal complete ring texts, and exact okoaiin in the lower ring plus f89v1.14. The image/text ownership is contextual: it does not certify that this particular group names the Sun or belongs to a written predicate.

GDT1051 preserves directed formal composition and the extra internal o in okoaiin relative to okaiin. Similar qokaiin/chokaiin cannot be substituted for the exact whole. E's comparison currently binds no medical predicate, negation or body-region argument.
design.additional_assumption: Hypothesize only that the exact whole okoaiin contributes a directed influence relation, not an object-name. Its two arguments must be licensed by one explicit construction, allowing a pictured local owner only when its use is stated. This does not hypothesize values for neighbouring words or assign Sun/Moon to either first group.

finite_content_core.model: INFLUENCE(SOURCE, DRUG); REMOVE_HUMOURS(DRUG, INCLUDED_REGION); NOT REMOVE_HUMOURS(DRUG, EXCLUDED_REGION).
finite_content_core.relation_assignment_budget: One proposed whole value, okoaiin=INFLUENCE, remains a working guess. INFLUENCE is an analyst predicate, not a confirmed gloss. Argument variables and the two further source relations are semantic obligations, not freely assigned target dictionary entries.
finite_content_core.binding_rule_to_freeze_before_applicatio: One ordered two-argument predicate construction must cover both exact occurrences. Any implicit argument requires the same declared local-owner rule; a free argument supplied from another page is forbidden. The pharmaceutical continuation must reuse the very drug receiving influence as the agent of its bodily effect; no fresh unrelated drug can satisfy the second clause.
finite_content_core.complete_context_limit: All other groups remain unresolved. The ring pair must both be retained, including the absence of exact okoaiin in the upper ring. That absence prevents calling this an already repeated paired-ring predicate construction. A full reading must explain that distinction, rather than importing a synonym for the upper ring.
finite_content_core.date_limit: The exact comparator is a later15th-century witness. It supplies an attested mechanism, not proof of an early15th-century target source, author or wording.

design.strongest_known_countercase: E_ROOT_RESULT already found that the Sun/gold branches leave282 of288 reader-record groups unresolved and supply no bound predicate or negation. Reclassifying the single shared word does not remove that failure. The counterpart ring does not contain the same whole, and the pharmacy illustration supplies no independently identified body-region owner. GDT1051 is formal coverage only. The source text names stars rather than the Sun in its region-selective drug example, so that passage cannot be used to identify okoaiin as Sun.
design.smallest_next_test: Author one complete syntactic-role sheet for the two existing rings and f89 paragraph, retaining all groups and all three alternative readings. Before any extra word meaning, freeze the same ordered two-argument construction around both exact okoaiin occurrences and check whether it can bind a stable drug participant to the second relation in the whole paragraph. Keep the head/neck/breast versus lower-members negation as an explicit unresolved requirement until written support exists. If only an actor-name plus arbitrary neighbours can be produced, or the two-place construction needs separate rules, return missing binding rather than declaring an influence reading. This is a small local authoring test, not new parsing infrastructure.
design.new_input_vs_predecessors: IDEA640 already proposed a generic relation/state rival across these exact units; this is an explicitly subordinate, more constrained candidate, not a claim to discover that match. The additional content is Q1's owned asymmetric source–drug–included/excluded-body chain. IDEA762 selects a different mediated florin/quenching recipe. That particular recipe and generic SOL=gold retain their scope correction. No J whole-passage lexicon or GDT963 code is reused.
design.assessment: RAW only. This is a dependent specialization of640, not an independently confirmed relation packet. No target interpretation, source identity or chronology has been established.
